title: Perfect World
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Tsugumi Kawana, a 26-year-old interior designer, reunites with her high school crush Itsuki Ayukawa, now an architect who uses a wheelchair after a spinal cord injury. At first she doubts she could date a man in a wheelchair, but her feelings change, and the josei drama follows their relationship through family disapproval, health crises and the realities of living with disability. It won the Kodansha Manga Award for shojo in 2019.
life_message: Love means choosing a whole person, including the hardships, and building a life together honestly.
